s-1.ptxt: Install Inner Rear View Mirror Assembly (Inner Mirror: EC Mirror)

s2.ptxt: Slide the inner rear view mirror assembly in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration.
Using a torx socket wrench (T20), install the inner rear view mirror assembly with the screw.

s-1.ptxt: Install Inner Rear View Mirror Stay Holder Cover (Inner Mirror: EC Mirror)

s2.ptxt: Engage the 6 claws of the inner rear view mirror cover.
Slide it in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration, engage the 2 claws and install the inner rear view mirror cover.

s-1.ptxt: Install Inner Rear View Mirror Assembly (Inner Mirror: Normal)

s2.ptxt: Slide the inner rear view mirror assembly in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to install it.

atten3.ptxt: Check that the lock lever is securely locked.

s2.ptxt: Engage the 2 claws and install the inner rear view mirror cover.
